rebuttal_or_critique: I acknowledge the concerns raised by Prof. Varma regarding a more calibrated approach; however, given that headline CPI at 7.01% is substantially above our target and core inflation remains sticky at 6.20%, the risk of inflation expectations becoming unanchored is significant. While my priority remains the rural economy and agricultural stability, the current positive output gap of 0.40% suggests that the economy can absorb a 50 bps increase. This front-loading is essential to effectively manage the spillover effects of global commodity prices and the depreciation of the rupee, ensuring that we do not fall behind the curve in our primary mandate of price stability.
